# Introduction

Dvergr rogues are neutral creatures found in the Mistlands, especially around Dvergr settlements. They resemble short, blue humanoids with light blue eyes and silver hair carrying an Arbalest. Rogues that spawn at Dvergr structures will often be accompanied by a mix of other rogues and/or Dvergr mages; unlike mages, however, rogues may spawn (and respawn) anywhere in the Mistlands.
Once provoked by a player (by damaging them, other nearby Dvergr, or any part of a nearby structure that is protected by a Dvergr Ward), they will become hostile and attack.
Dvergr are naturally hostile to other aggressive creatures in the Mistlands and will attack them on sight. Clearing at least one dvergr settlement is necessary to progress in the Mistlands, because the Dvergr component crate contains the Dvergr extractor, an essential component in the Sap extractor. This can be circumvented by ramming the relevant crate with a cart or hoping that aggressive mobs in the area destroy it.

### Spawning

• Type: Middle of the Mistlands during the day time | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Uncommon | Stars: Yes

• Type: Common spawn point in Dvergr forts and structures | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: Yes

### Shoot

Lifts one leg to support and load their crossbow before shooting the player (110 Pierce damage). The arrow travels at 40 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 2–20 degrees. This attack can be used every 6 seconds when within 1–15 meters of a player.

### Melee

Smacks the player with the side of their crossbow (70 Blunt damage). This attack swings in a 2.5-meter 90-degree horizontal arc and can be used every 4 seconds when within 0.5–2.5 meters of a player.
